description: This file contains utility functions used in the frontend API layer. It provides methods to build query strings from parameters and to determine the base URL for API requests, accommodating different environments and configurations.

methods.name: buildQueryString
methods.description: Constructs a URL query string from a given parameters object, ignoring undefined, null, or empty string values.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API calls, prioritizing environment variables and falling back to window location or localhost.
